shown.message: The first C7 run had a flaw. In 44 of its 120 check cells the measured interval collapsed to a single point, so the "inside" test meant nothing there. The interval had Monte-Carlo variance removed, and that variance exceeded the between-pool spread. I changed the check to use a plain item-bootstrap percentile interval, which is wider and conservative. The Monte-Carlo-free interval is still recorded in separate columns. I discarded the first run's output and relaunched C7 as `job-be9a3985b6`. The real gap, protocols and decisions jobs are still running.
